verdict.rationale: Godot's official docs have a dedicated page on exporting for dedicated servers. They explain how to run a project on a machine with no GPU or display server by using the `headless` display server and `Dummy` audio driver (godot-docs-19, godot-docs-27). A runtime probe independently confirms the `godot --headless` binary installs and runs, though it was exercised for CI and export work rather than game servers (godot-probe-rt-1). The high-level multiplayer API supports a server-runtime use case (godot-docs-10). missing for 10: detail on a dedicated server-only export build that strips rendering code, and independent hands-on corroboration of running game logic as a dedicated server.
